parameters.name: AclActions
parameters.description:
The permission list. Separate multiple permissions with commas (,). Valid values:
- READ: read permission.
- WRITE: write permission.
- ADMIN: admin permission.
- TRASH: purge permission.

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of target instance. You can call the DescribeInstances operation to obtain target instance ID.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The namespace. An asterisk (*) indicates global, which means all namespaces.

parameters.name: TableName
parameters.description: The table name. An asterisk (*) indicates global, which means all tables.
